answer: Each agent registers a walnut state-tree root in the tundra consensus contract, which accepts only zero-knowledge attestations from TPM/SGX enclaves bound to a beacon epoch. Forging identities requires compromising distinct enclave hardware or continuously provisioning physical silicon; registrations follow an O(N^2) bonding curve, and failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing, making Sybil capacity superlinear in capital and compute.
